Hi Lena — Monica here (solutions engineering / security). A few technical clarifications in advance of the walkthrough: 

- Network isolation: Our Private VPC deployment runs in a customer-owned VPC (BYO VPC) or in a dedicated Redwood VPC with strict peering. We can provide either a peered VPC model (uses VPC peering or Transit Gateway) or a PrivateLink setup for more control over egress points.

- Subnets & routing: Typically we recommend two private subnets per AZ for worker nodes, with a management subnet for control-plane access. No inbound public IPs on worker nodes in the private model.

- Air-gapped option: For fully air-gapped environments we provide an on-prem bundle with offline model artifacts and an orchestration image. This requires physical transfer of model artifacts and a scheduled security review for updates.

- KMS/HSM: We integrate with customer KMS (AWS KMS, GCP KMS) and support HSM-backed key stores for encryption of persisted caches and model keys.

I'll prepare a short slide (1-2 pages) mapping your questionnaire sections to our controls and include a network flow focused on the peering/egress controls.

I'll join the call on Thu 05/13 at 10:00 PST unless you prefer another slot.

Cheers,
Monica Patel
